verdict.rationale: Temporal documents a programmatic Client that lets applications start Workflow Executions, send Signals and Queries, retrieve results, and manage Standalone Activities. Its SDKs expose documented APIs for Workflow and Activity execution, and the official CLI plus a Cloud extension manage Namespaces, users, service accounts and API keys. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI probes returned 404), evidence of a documented raw gRPC/HTTP API reference outside the SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
